```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)
```

```{r}
data <- read.csv("../Data/Video Games Sales (1980-2024) - Raw.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

str(data)
summary(data)
```

```{r}
clean_data <- data
```

```{r}
clean_data <- clean_data %>%
  distinct(title, console, release_date, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r}
sum(duplicated(clean_data))
```

```{r}
clean_data <- clean_data %>%
  mutate(
    title = trimws(title),
    console = trimws(console),
    genre = trimws(genre),
    publisher = trimws(publisher),
    developer = trimws(developer),
    release_date = trimws(release_date)
  )
```

```{r}
clean_data <- clean_data %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.numeric(substr(release_date, nchar(release_date)-3, nchar(release_date)))
  )
```

```{r}
summary(clean_data$year)
sum(is.na(clean_data$year))
```

```{r}
# Rows where release_date cannot be parsed
problem_dates <- clean_data %>%
  filter(is.na(dmy(release_date)) & is.na(mdy(release_date)) & is.na(ymd(release_date))) %>%
  select(title, console, release_date)

head(problem_dates, 20)
```

```{r}
# Clean whitespace first
data <- data %>% 
  mutate(release_date_clean = str_trim(release_date))

# Try parsing all formats
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    release_date2 = dmy(release_date_clean),
    release_date2 = if_else(is.na(release_date2), mdy(release_date_clean), release_date2),
    release_date2 = if_else(is.na(release_date2), ymd(release_date_clean), release_date2),
    year = year(release_date2)
  )

# Identify problematic rows
problem_dates <- data %>% filter(is.na(release_date2)) %>% select(title, console, release_date_clean)
nrow(problem_dates)
head(problem_dates, 20)
```

```{r}
data <- data %>%
  filter(is.na(year) | (year >= 1970 & year <= 2024))
```

```{r}
sapply(data, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))
```

```{r}
problem_dates <- data %>% filter(is.na(release_date2)) %>% select(title, console, release_date)

```
```{r}
data <- data %>% mutate(diff = total_sales - (na_sales + jp_sales + pal_sales + other_sales))
summary(data$diff)
```

```{r}
colSums(is.na(data))
```

```{r}
data %>% filter(is.na(year))
```

```{r}
  data$release_date_clean <- str_trim(data$release_date)

# Parse date: try multiple formats
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    release_date2 = dmy(release_date_clean),
    release_date2 = if_else(is.na(release_date2), mdy(release_date_clean), release_date2),
    release_date2 = if_else(is.na(release_date2), ymd(release_date_clean), release_date2),
    year = year(release_date2)
  )

# Filter out rows with invalid dates
data <- data %>% filter(!is.na(release_date2))
```

```{r}
data <- data %>%
  mutate(Check_Total = na_sales + jp_sales + pal_sales + other_sales,
         Difference = total_sales - Check_Total,
         Total_Sales_Rounded = round(total_sales, 2))

summary(data$Difference)
```
```{r}
sapply(data, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))
```

```{r}
nrow(data)
```
```{r}
write.csv(data, "video_game_sales_cleaned.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
